note: Ground-truth fields for validating the Intake Agent's extraction against each test file. All names, IDs, and case numbers are synthetic.

cases.scenario: Typical, well-formed appeal email with one PDF attachment
cases.notes: Baseline happy-path case. Attachment should be OCR'd and its fields (diagnosis, treatment history) merged into the same case record as the email body fields.

cases.scenario: Informal, unstructured email from a family member — no member ID, no attachment

expected_fields.procedure_requested: additional physical therapy sessions (post hip surgery)

cases.notes: Tests the Intake Agent's handling of missing required fields. Expected behavior is to extract whatever is present, flag member_id and case_reference as missing, and hold the case at 'Needs Clarification' rather than silently proceeding to summarization. Use this case to validate the flagging logic, not just extraction accuracy.

cases.scenario: Forwarded provider-office email, two attachments (PDF case packet + plain-text denial letter)
cases.notes: Tests forwarded-thread parsing (the real sender's identity is in the quoted block, not the From header) and multi-attachment, mixed-format handling (PDF + plain text) in one email.

cases.scenario: Clean, typed, structured clinical record — direct upload
cases.notes: Baseline happy-path upload case — same underlying case as EMAIL-001's attachment, so results should match when the same file arrives via either channel.

cases.scenario: Prose-heavy physician appeal letter, no tables, no ICD-10 codes stated explicitly
cases.notes: Tests extraction from free-text narrative rather than a labeled table — member_id and diagnosis codes are genuinely absent from the source document, so a correct extraction should return null/empty for those rather than guessing.

cases.scenario: Two-page record with a lab-results table and a page break mid-document
cases.notes: Tests table extraction (7-row lab panel) and correct field association across a page break — the clinical justification and physician signature are on page 2.
